title: SES AI Appoints Paul Diemer to Board of Directors
summary: Diemer brings decades of experience scaling innovation in energy storage systems SES AI Corporation (“SES AI”) (NYSE: SES), a global leader in the development and manufacturing of AI-enhanced high-performance Li-Metal and Li-ion batteries, today announced it has appointed Paul Diemer to the Company’s Board of Directors. Mr. Diemer previously served as Chief Technology Officer for Flex's Power business, where he led the global research and development and technology organizations responsible for embedded and critical power systems for AI datacenters, overseeing more than 1,000 engineers across 14 countries. In addition to Flex, Mr. Diemer previously oversaw new EV product architectures at BorgWarner and currently serves as SVP of Corporate Engineering at Generac Power Systems.
